topic: Pure Fourier Series: Decoding the Language of Waves

sections.title: The Core Intuition: The 'Orchestra' Analogy
lecture_lines: Complex signals are sums of simple sine waves.
Think of an orchestra playing a single chord.
Fourier reveals individual notes within that chord.

sections.title: The Mathematical Foundation: Basis Functions
lecture_lines: Fourier series defines signals by basis functions.
Sine and cosine waves act as independent axes.
They combine to reconstruct any complex wave.
animations: Draw a sine wave #FFFFFF labeled as 'f1'. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg]
Draw a higher frequency cosine wave #FF00FF labeled as 'f2'.
Show the summation formula #00FFFF adding f1 and f2. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg]

sections.title: Calculating Coefficients: The 'Sieve' Method
lecture_lines: Integration extracts the amplitude of each component.
The integral acts as a precise frequency filter.
It sieves out specific components from signals.
animations: Display an irregular input signal wave #FFFFFF.
Slide a circular frequency sieve #FF00FF across the signal.
Show the isolated coefficient #00FFFF appearing for the frequency.

sections.title: Visualizing Convergence: The Square Wave Demo
lecture_lines: Adding terms creates sharper, more accurate waves.
Convergence improves as we add more terms.
Gibbs phenomenon causes overshoot at signal corners.
animations: Show a static rectangular square wave outline #FFFFFF using the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/oscilloscope.svg].

Highlight the overshoot tip #FFFF00 representing Gibbs phenomenon.

sections.title: Real-World Application & Summary
lecture_lines: Fourier transforms time-domain to frequency-domain data.
Spectrum analyzers visualize these frequency components.
Compression algorithms use this to remove data.
animations: Display a waveform #FFFFFF switching to frequency bars.
Show spectrum analyzer bars #FF00FF fluctuating in real-time using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/analyzer.svg].
